sourceProjection.basis: The overhead site diagram has an orthogonal refectory and an independently angled ticket-office perimeter. That actual angled wall is retained; the source is not an oblique view.

review: Official orthographic plan p1. The ticket office is genuinely diagonal to the refectory, not an oblique projection. Preserve its angle. Paths0-35 are structural outlines except courtyard surface31; 39-45/57/60-63 are visitation arrows, excluded from walls. Paintings have explicit source wall bars54/55. The museum entrance is at lower right, not the ticket-office entrance at left. No numbered rooms exist on source; use actual place names, not invented numerical room IDs.
